description: Returns the hotel results for a running search identified by `searchKey` (from `hotel_search`). Results stream in asynchronously, so POLL this tool until the returned `searchStatus` equals `COMPLETED` (it is `IN_PROGRESS` while results are still loading). Supports `page` (0-indexed on BOTH the request and the response echo — page 0 is the first page and comes back as page 0), `size` (use a large value like 5000 to get all), `filters` (minPrice/maxPrice/starRatings/amenities/mealTypes/hotelName/minDiscountScore), `sortBy` (PRICE_ASC/PRICE_DESC/RATING_DESC/DISTANCE/VALUE_DESC), and `currency`. Returns `hotels[]` (each with `hotelId`, `name`, `starRating`, `minPrice`, `originalPrice`, `currency`, `discountScore`, `reviewScore`, `hasFreeCancellation`, `isRefundable`, etc.), plus `totalCount` and `hasMore`. `discountScore` is LockTrip's value score for the offer: an estimated % below the hotel's usual public price (the figure locktrip.com shows as "X% off"). Higher means better value; 20 or more is a strong deal; 0 or missing means no score. A low price is not the same as good value, so to find the best-value hotels use `sortBy` VALUE_DESC (highest discountScore first) or `filters.minDiscountScore` (e.g. 20), and weigh it with `starRating` and `reviewScore`. No authentication required. Pass a chosen `hotelId` together with the SAME `searchKey` to `get_hotel_rooms`.

currency.description: Currency code from hotel_search (prices are in this currency)

minDiscountScore.description: Only hotels whose discountScore is at least this value (0-100; e.g. 20 for strong deals)

size.description: Results per page (use 5000 to get all)

name: get_search_results
title: Get Hotel Search Results
